definition: the long top edge of a mountain or hill
description: A helmet-camera view straight down at a climber's red suit and boots as he stands on a knife-thin snow ridge. The ridge runs away from him in a long narrow crest of trodden snow that rises to a summit point, with a solid white sea of cloud far below on both sides and the curved horizon and deep blue sky beyond.
transcript: I walk right along the top of the world.
